definitions.explanation: A horizontal beam that carries the weight of the roof or the floor above, resting on pillars or walls.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{梁|はり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see the ceiling beams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古民家|こみんか}→古民家：11833_kominka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{梁|はり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Old farmhouses are built with thick beams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{梁|はり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{固定|こてい}する→固定する：19647_koteisuru⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To prepare for earthquakes, we had work done to fasten the pillars and beams firmly.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{梁|はり}: pillars and beams, the frame of a building
- ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{梁|はり}: thick beams
- {梁|はり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to lay a beam across

WATCH OUT:
- A homophone of ⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧ (needle). In compounds the kanji is read りょう, as in {橋梁|きょうりょう} (bridge).
